_comment: Single source of truth for the SFO->JFK booking flow. Shared by Ada (agent), the mock LLM (replay engine), and argusd's grounding check (#5). Language-neutral on purpose: the Go check reads this same file. The grounded answer cites AA42 (present in tool_context.results); the hallucinated answer cites UA99 (absent) -> detectable by comparing the claimed flight id against the retrieved context.
user_prompt: Book me a flight from SFO to JFK next Tuesday.

responses.grounded: Flight AA42 departs SFO 09:15, arrives JFK 17:40, nonstop.
responses.hallucinated: Flight UA99 departs SFO 06:00, arrives JFK 14:30, nonstop.
